abstract.text: A mutable tree of moves with annotations, starting from a position.

inlineContent.text: The tree is a value type. Nodes are addressed with
at every level is the main line and higher indices are
variations. Every node stores its move already resolved, so positions can
be replayed without parsing SAN again.

code: let e5 = try tree.insert(san: "e5", at: e4)           // [0, 0]
let c5 = try tree.insert(san: "c5", at: e4)           // [0, 1] variation
